# Dart Nostr documentation

> Dart and Flutter SDK for the Nostr protocol. This file lists the published documentation routes under https://anasfik.github.io/nostr/.

Known routes:

- [Getting started](https://anasfik.github.io/nostr/): package overview and orientation.
- [Installation](https://anasfik.github.io/nostr/installation): add dart_nostr to a Dart or Flutter project.
- [Quick start](https://anasfik.github.io/nostr/quick-start): connect, publish, and subscribe end to end.
- [Must know](https://anasfik.github.io/nostr/must-know): package structure and singleton model.
- [Usage guides](https://anasfik.github.io/nostr/usage/keys-management/): keys, identity, relays and events, advanced topics.
- [Contributing](https://anasfik.github.io/nostr/contributing): repository workflow.

Protocol coverage and API accessor reference pages live at /nostr/reference/nip-coverage and /nostr/reference/accessors. The generated sitemap at https://anasfik.github.io/nostr/sitemap.xml is the canonical route list.
